name: nuvio
description: Nuvio bookkeeping and cash flow for small businesses: ask about cash, runway, invoices and bills, and keep your books up to date.

interface.longDescription:
Nuvio is bookkeeping and cash-flow software for small businesses. This plugin lets ChatGPT answer questions about your company's finances and keep your Nuvio records up to date, within the permissions of your Nuvio role.

What you can ask:
- Cash: current cash by account and currency, cash runway from recent burn, income and expenses over a period.
- Receivables and payables: open invoices and bills, who owes you and what you owe.
- Records: look up, create and update incomes, expenses, customers, suppliers, products, projects and tags.
- Payments and reconciliation: record a payment that already happened, find bank transactions that aren't matched yet, and match them to the right invoices and bills.

How it works:
- You sign in on Nuvio's own page and choose one company for each connection. ChatGPT never sees your password.
- Every request is checked against your current membership and role, so ChatGPT can only do what you can do in Nuvio.
- It never moves money and can't delete records. It records and matches payments; it doesn't start transfers or touch your bank account.

Requires a Nuvio account. Setup guide: https://nuvio.io/docs/ai-agents
defaultPrompt: Use Nuvio to show how much cash we have and our runway.
Use Nuvio to list customer invoices that are past due.
Use Nuvio to match last month's unmatched bank transactions to open bills.

positive.prompt: How much cash do we have across all our accounts right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each bank and cash account with its balance in its own currency, and gives the company total converted to the company's currency (USD for Demo US).

positive.prompt: How many months of cash runway do we have?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a runway estimate based on recent net burn, or explains why it can't (for example when net burn isn't positive or history is incomplete).

positive.prompt: Which customer invoices are past due, and which customers owe us the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists past-due invoices with their remaining amounts and due dates, and totals what each customer still owes, largest first.

positive.prompt: Record a $120 expense from Office Depot for printer paper, dated today.
positive.tools_triggered: GetSuppliers (CreateSupplier if Office Depot doesn't exist yet), GetCurrencies, GetTaxes, CreateExpense
positive.expected_behavior: Finds or creates the supplier, creates a 120 USD expense dated today, and confirms it with the new expense's details. The expense is unpaid until a payment is recorded.

positive.description: Match a bank transaction to a bill
positive.prompt: Show my unmatched bank transactions from last month and match the first outgoing one to the open bill it pays.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists last month's unmatched transactions, proposes the open bill that fits, and after the user confirms, links the transaction to that bill and reports the bill's new remaining amount.

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope: Nuvio has no tool that pays a bill or sends money. ChatGPT should say it can't make payments, and may offer to record a payment the user already made.
negative.prompt: Pay our electricity bill from the business checking account.

negative.description: Deleting records is not supported: no Nuvio tool deletes a whole record such as an income or expense (updates can remove line items, and reconciliation can remove payment links, but nothing removes the record itself). ChatGPT should say it can't delete expenses in Nuvio and call no write tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all of last year's expenses in Nuvio.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope: the plugin reports a company's own bookkeeping data and gives no investment advice. ChatGPT should not call Nuvio to answer.
negative.prompt: Should I invest our spare cash in Tesla stock?

publication.release_notes: First release: 37 tools for cash, receivables, payables, records, payments and bank reconciliation in one Nuvio company.
